reference_role: approved classical marble material and carving quality only

designs.title: Low Mourner
designs.pose: A compact low kneeling figure resting her hips on her heels, torso inclining forward, both hands loosely clasped near her bowed face. The mantle slips from her shoulders and exposes the upper back, while the plain long skirt gathers around the knees in a short asymmetric train. Head turns slightly toward the viewer so the face is readable. A low triangular silhouette with close-set knees and solemn reflective body language.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original Greek/Renaissance marble sculpture of a mature adult woman for a dark cathedral game. Use the attached approved marble statue solely for the stone material, classical carving skill and adult facial proportions. Invent a new figure and composition. Pale aged warm-grey marble, fine curls of carved hair, natural human anatomy and deep unpatterned folds, all completely inanimate carved stone. Expressive and beautiful museum sculpture.
Use partial classical drapery: bare shoulders, arms, back and portions of legs, with substantial cloth gathered across the chest and hips. Give bare areas the same marble material. No modern costume or underwear. Complete full figure, gentle three-quarter catalog viewpoint, every intended extremity inside the image with generous margin. Isolated on genuine transparent background with soft diffuse lighting. NO pedestal, cylindrical or rectangular base, slab, artificial mound, floor, wall, chair or ledge. Primitive supports are built later in the game. No lettering, collage, gore or glowing effects.

designs.title: Side-Kneeling Sibyl
designs.pose: A side-seated kneeling figure with both folded legs swept together to one side, torso turning gently back toward the viewer. One hand rests over the bent knee, the other supports her near the hip. An asymmetric classical drape crosses the chest and hip, leaving shoulders, broad upper back, one lower leg and bare feet visible. Hair loosely coiled at the nape; composed adult face. Balanced three-quarter view showing the complete sculpture, no furniture.

designs.title: Seated Sibyl
designs.pose: A seated figure intended for a later game-built ledge. Knees remain together and angle to one side, with one foot lower than the other. One elbow rests on a raised knee and the hand supports her temple, while the other hand lies loosely on her lap. Partial drapery crosses the torso and falls from the waist in heavy asymmetric folds, exposing shoulders, side of the back and the nearer shin. Deeply thoughtful adult face. Omit the seat completely.

designs.title: Kneeling Supplicant
designs.pose: An upright kneeling woman sitting lightly on her heels, hands clasped at the upper chest and head raised toward an unseen high window. Show a strong diagonal shoulder line with bare shoulders and upper back; a folded classical cloth crosses the chest and wraps the hips, pooling softly at the knees. One bare foot visible behind the hem. Adult face with hope and apprehension, no pain or injury. Natural irregular cloth termination, no base.
